reason_summary: r3 pinned a normalisation contract that hard-required output_token_ids for every arm, but the frozen dense producer never emits token ids; the one r3 dense smoke GPU attempt fail-closed inside normalize_record before writing any file. The executable surface must be fixed and re-pinned, so r3 is superseded with no results lost (it wrote nothing).

single_reason.problem: evaluation/run_edge576_cvbench_three_arm.py::normalize_record required ('output_text', 'output_token_ids', 'selected_group_indices') and edge576_cvbench_runner_contract.REQUIRED_EDGE_RECORD_FIELDS listed output_token_ids, but evaluation/run_hf_shallow_block_pruning.py::run_one (the dense producer) returns only output_text, the real integer count output_tokens and selected_group_indices. Only the frozen L2 and v2 producers emit output_token_ids.
single_reason.first_failure: The first r3 real-model execution (dense_edge576, sample_id 1838, cuda:0) completed model load, one warmup and one sample inference and then raised Edge576ContractError: frozen dense_edge576 record is missing 'output_token_ids' (fail closed) before opening the output stream.
single_reason.fix_in_r4: Make output_token_ids optional and never fabricate it; require an auditable output_token_count mapped from the real frozen fields (output_token_ids length and/or output_tokens, which must agree), add output_token_ids_available, and keep fail-closed core-field validation. r4 re-pins the fixed execution layer and repeats the model-identity -> three-arm smoke pass -> full2638 order.

execution_layer_pin_drift.note: The r3-pinned bytes of these files were the ones executing during the failed attempt; r4 re-pins the fixed bytes under the same pin names.

scoping: CPU-only, read-only while writing this evidence. The r3 config/report/generator/test bytes and the frozen r2 evidence are preserved unchanged. No GPU, no model weights, no network, no training, no dependency installation in this task.
